proof_arguments.step: All four convex residuals are nonpositive; multipliers 1/N,k/N,(k+1)/(alpha N),k/(alpha N) are nonnegative. Hence V_{k+1}<=V_k.
proof_arguments.base: V_0=0 exactly; separate first-step identity verified. W_0=D_h(x_star,x_0)/(alpha N)<=R/(alpha N).
proof_arguments.signs: Convexity gives r_f,r_h<=0 and D_h>=0; alpha N>0. No strong convexity or positivity of R is needed.
proof_arguments.domain: N integer >=1; alpha>0; R>=0; k integer 0..N-1. N=1 uses the separately checked first step and terminal identity, R=0 is allowed.
proof_arguments.normalization: The exact finite-horizon denominator is alpha*N and initial radius is R, not R squared.
